source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: On top of the wall is a well dressed man in his mid 50s with an old worn military coat over his fine clothes.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He is instructing the other "guards" on how to open and close the gate so that the group of heroes can enter the town.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra is surprised to see her father wearing the old uniform, because he is not a military man, but he explains that he was having trouble organizing the town after they received the message from the north.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He explains that not long before the group arrived a messenger arrived with a dire message from Edge, the town to the north on the outskirts of the Swamp.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The messenger claimed the town was under siege from horrific monsters and that a group of survivors were leaving for Mireward Reach, but no one had arrived.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: After such a long stretch of peace, and no other recent word from the town, people had lost interest and grown complacent.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra quickly reads the message to the group, which sounds exactly like the monsters they faced in Mirathorn; slimy monsters and flying meat creatures along with changes to people's eyes.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Now she is trying to decide what they should do next, help out her hometown or go directly north to help Edge.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: After a brief discussion, she decides they need to speak with the town leader.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: They all head to the Inn where they can clearly hear lots of voices before they even open the doors.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Inside they find the common room packed with people, all shouting over one another until one loud and clear voice silences the rest.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Another well dressed man, most likely a former merchant around the same age as Lysandro, addresses the crowd.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: As mayor, Orik Tane can easily command the room.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He agrees with the crowd that he is not certain if the danger is real, but they have never received a message like this before.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The problem is if there is a real threat, who from the town will be able to go and help fight.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: That's when the door swings open again and six very experienced adventurers enter.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: And, as shocked as the crowd is to see this new group, they are more shocked to see "little" Lysandra with them.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Without wasting any time with greetings and formalities, she quickly explains the mission they are on from Mirathorn and how the group has fought back these same monsters before.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Instead of relief, this causes more concern as most of the people here believed that the threat was overblown.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Suddenly everyone can hear yelling and a loud bell ringing coming from outside.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: A very tired and very scared boy slams open the door.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Through his heavy breathing he explains that shadows are coming from the Reach to the north gate.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Without hesitation Stafl casts Celestial Revelation and flies up and out of the Inn to the top of the north gate.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: People are stunned into silence, now fully aware that this new group is fully in charge of the situation.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Stafl casts Light on a crossbow bolt and fires it out onto the road coming to the gate.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: With the dim light he created he can make out lots of shadows, anywhere from twenty to one hundred.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Then there is a banging on the gate below.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Before anyone can react they hear voices yelling "they're coming, let us in".

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna rushes to the gate, but protests just letting the people in.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: They are able to determine that there are around fifty people in this group, much less than what they started out with when they evacuated to Mireward.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: A clear leader of the group steps forward, Brin Holloway, a cook from Edge, who quickly tells how they all narrowly escaped as the town was surrounded and overrun by horrible meat monsters.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna explains that they will need to see the eyes of each person before they can enter, something Brin says he knows what they are looking for.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: But before they can start this plan, Kasemine can feel the ground rumble, dirt vibrating as something big, or many things, approach the town.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She quickly climbs to the top of the wall and with her dark vision can just make out multiple forms, some huge, slowly approaching.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Stafl quickly forms a plan.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: He instructs the survivors to follow the wall around the city and to find the south gate and wait there.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Inside he tells the guards to watch the people, but to not let them in until the town is secure.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The rest of the group joins Stafl and Karsemine on the wall to begin forming a plan.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo throws some ball bearings down in front of the gate while Karsemine casts Spike Growth in a 20 foot area providing difficult terrain and large spiky thorns along the road.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: They can see the group of large shadows enter the tangle of thorns, but then stop.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The rest of the shadows behind start to go around the area as the others back up, all while taking piercing damage from the thorns.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Now that the shadows are within 120 feet Ephanna can finally see the group of terrifying creatures: two giant tripod meat monsters, a golem like creature, a swarm of flying meatwing monsters, two meat hybrid monsters and two of the sewer monsters they fought in Mirathorn.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine and Ephanna are first to plan their attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karesmine steadies her bow, waiting for the creatures to get within range, while Ephanna casts Hunger of Hadar on a point in their path.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Now any creature inside will be blinded and take cold and acid damage, however the rest of the team cannot see into the magical sphere as well.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Now Bonogo, Thrin and Baergrom all ready themselves, but also hold their attack until the monsters are in range.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The two sewer monsters are caught inside the sphere of darkness and take both cold and acid damage as they end their attack still inside.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The terrifying tripod creatures, 15 feet tall, bulbous and covered in skulls, sink their legs into the ground and then rip off a part of their body and launch it at the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Both land just short, but then transform into more small meat monsters.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Now within range, Karsemine shoots one of them with her bow, while Baergrom attempts to shoot the other with his crossbow, but misses.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Thrin kills the other with a shot from his bow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The flying meat creatures take cold damage, but then quickly fly out of the sphere and closer to the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo fires an arrow at the flying monsters and gets a kill.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Stafl gives a potion with Bless to Bonogo then also kills a flying creature with his crossbow.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The golem moves closer to the wall, but due to its slow movement, takes cold and acid damage and remains inside the sphere of darkness.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra steps forward and uses her Commanding Shout and commands Karsemine, Bonogo and Baergrom to take another shot at the flying monsters.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karesmine and Bonogo both land hits, but Baergrom misses again.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn, channeling magic, casts Snowball on a group of enemies, dealing cold damage to one of the tripod creatures and two more flying monsters.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Finally, the disgusting meat hybrid creatures trudge forward, but not before taking cold damage from Ephanna's spell.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Back on the wall, Karsemine uses her Hunter's Mark on one of the tripod creatures, allowing her to learn its weaknesses and resistances.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: She discovers valuable information for her team - the creatures are resistant to poison, but weak to fire.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: With this new information she takes aim again with her bow, but misses the shot.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Ephanna uses Eldritch Blast on two of the flying meatwings, killing both, then summons Ogonob who jumps over the wall and attacks the small summoned meat monster.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: After delivering a killing blow, it dashes father out away from the wall and closer to the approaching horde then, using Fey step, creates a cube of darkness around itself.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Bonogo and Thrin both fire off arrows, but miss their targets.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Baergorm fires his crossbow, hitting and killing one of the flying meatwings.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The giant sewer creatures both lumber closer to the wall, again taking damage from Ephanna's spell.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The equally giant tripod creatures move closer still, then again throw new meat monsters at the attackers on the wall.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The first one falls short, hits the wall, then becomes a new flying meatwing.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The second finds its target, hitting Caelynn directly in the face, dealing damage and creating another meatwing.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The creature then flies up, ready to attack Caelynn again, but creates a perfect opportunity for Lysandra and Karsemine to strike.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Karsemine quickly lunges out as the first one flies by and kills it before it can attack.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Lysandra, leaping off the half wall and making an incredible jump straight up, misses her attack, but follows through to kill the second monster with a swift slice.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Meanwhile, the other six remaining meatwings from the horde move within range of the wall and begin to cast some sort of charm.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Both Bonogo and Ephanna no longer feel compelled to attack the meatwings.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Stafl, seeing the incredible attacks from Karsemine, casts Bardic Inspiration on her, then casts Sleep on one of the tripod creatures.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: The lone golem continues its slow march toward the wall while taking additional cold damage.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Along the wall the heroes can feel magic and the static of electricity building.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Caelynn, furious after the barrage of attacks, lines herself up and unleashes a devastating lightning bolt along the line of attackers, dealing massive damage to a group of meatwings, a meat hybrid and one of the tripods.

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
lexical_plain: Will this be enough to turn the tide of battle, or will Mireward Reach be overrun?

source_recap_path: Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Recaps/_normalized/Session 23 - Mireward Gate Battle.md
